about_the_game:
Embrace the unpredictable. Bend reality. Tip the scales… or shatter them.

The Chaos Pack is a wild new skill tree that brings glorious randomness to every battle. Whether you're helping or hurting, casting or cloning, dodging or detonating, chaos is your new best friend. This DLC adds 30+ unique, chaos-infused skills that can be unlocked and used in both Campaign and Roguelike modes, offering a high-risk, high-reward playstyle unlike anything you've seen before.

Will your next move turn the tide of battle—or blow it to pieces? Only chaos knows.

🎲 Just a Taste of the Chaos

  • 🎩 Magic Hat
    Pull anything out of thin air—shrines, barrels, globules—you name it. Your enemies won't know what hit them. Literally.

  • 🧠 Telekinesis
    Move any object with the power of your mind. Rearrange the battlefield, toss barrels at foes, or just make a mess of things—your call.

  • 🔄 Switcheroo
    Instantly swap places with any character—or even a barrel. Confuse your enemies. Confuse your friends. Confuse yourself.

  • 💥 Replicate
    Create a clone of yourself that explodes in a brilliant blast upon death. Twice the power, twice the chaos.

  • 🌩️ Chaos Cloud
    Rain down a storm of six possible damage types from the heavens. Fire, ice, shadow, lightning... hope you packed your umbrella.

  • ✨ Multicast
    Every spell you cast has a chance to be cast again. Double the spells, double the mayhem.

  • ⚡ Disruption
    Grants a chance to completely avoid incoming damage. Sometimes. Maybe. Probably.

  • ❤️ Helping / ☠️ Hurting
    Random buffs and debuffs for everyone! The battlefield becomes a grab bag of blessings and curses—good luck!

Over 30 new skills for two game modes. Infinite chaos.

The Chaos Pack is for those who don’t just play by the rules—they throw them in a barrel, light them on fire, and teleport the barrel into a boss fight.

Add a little uncertainty to your build. Add a little madness to your magic. Add the Chaos Pack.
